description: This Java class 'FundsHelper' provides utility methods for creating and managing 'Funds' objects in the context of integration tests for the Apache Fineract project. It includes builder pattern implementation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and overrides for equality and hash code.

classes.name: FundsHelper
classes.description: Utility class representing a fund with properties such as name and external ID, including serialization and comparison methods.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the fund.

methods.name: getExternalId
methods.description: Returns the external ID of the fund.

methods.name: getResourceId
methods.description: Returns the resource ID of the fund.

methods.name: toJSON
methods.description: Serializes the FundsHelper object to a JSON string.

methods.name: fromJSON
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string into a FundsHelper object.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory method to start building a FundsHelper instance with a specified name.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides the default hashCode method, primarily based on the 'name' property.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides the default equals method to compare FundsHelper objects based on 'name'.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: Builder pattern class for constructing FundsHelper objects with optional externalId.

methods.name: externalId
methods.description: Sets the external ID for the fund.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs a FundsHelper instance using the Builder.
